captions.detailed: A professional shoulder-mount camcorder model in dark gray and black. It features a boxy main body, a top carry handle with hot shoe mounts, a rear cylindrical viewfinder, and a long front-mounted lens assembly. On its left side, a two-part articulated LCD screen is connected via a support arm and hinge mechanism.
captions.instruction: Generate a professional shoulder-mount camcorder with a boxy main body, a top carry handle, a rear viewfinder, a detailed front lens, and a side-mounted, two-axis articulated LCD screen.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a Box primitive. Build the lens and rear viewfinder using Cylinder primitives of varying diameters. Assemble the top handle from box segments, and create the articulated LCD screen by joining a side hinge bracket, an extension arm, and a thin panel representing the monitor.
